phase_prompt.summary: Narel stands as the solitary administrator of the seasonal quadrant, manipulating the heavy data-glass of the sky-dome controls with a burden of infinite recurrence.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A hyper-realistic, vertical cinematic shot of Narel, a humanoid entity composed of polished obsidian and internal fiber optics, standing against a backdrop of deep atmospheric server-void darkness. He wears robes that resemble flowing liquid metal. He is looking down at a holographic control surface made of fractured glass shards filled with scrolling code. The lighting is moody, dramatic, and cool-toned, highlighting the texture of his skin and the weariness in his hyper-detailed eyes. 8k, photorealistic, dramatic shadows.
